720-1385-1806-2034.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
720-1385-1806-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adidng {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Kinzu of the Bleak Coven and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Kinzu of the Bleak Coven trigger, causing you to pay 2 life and exile Eternal Scourge from your graveyard to create a token copy of it that is 1/1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

1479-5621-8293.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Cleveland Booker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

339-574-677-6968.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
339-574-677-6968.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

116-1436-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
116-1436-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

628-1478-2018.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Elder by sacrificing it.
When Sakura-Tribe Elder dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Sakura-Tribe Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Sakura-Tribe Elder ability
Activate Sakura-Tribe Elder by sacrificing it.
When Sakura-Tribe Elder dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Sakura-Tribe Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Sakura-Tribe Elder ability
Repeat

5166-7872--86.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Black Panther to take damage.
5166-7872--86.description:
Cause Black Panther to take damage by any method.
Black Panther triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Black Panther.
Repeat from step 2.

2111-2438-3545.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2099-2111-6792.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the other Angel on the battlefield

3259-4068-7917--185.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-7917--185.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Seluma, triggering both Breath of Fury and Seluma.
Resolve the Seluma trigger, returning an Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4068-7917--185.notes: One of the two additional Angels must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard. If both chosen Angels have haste, then Anger can be omitted.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2099-2122-6972.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Mindless Automaton.
When Mindless Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

2919-4186-6830-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-4186-6830-7810.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2187-6573.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2187-6573.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone two or more times this game.
1987-2187-6573.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2187-6573.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

339-677-2034-5434.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

6461-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat

2511-3112-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Slurrk.
When Slurrk dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve Slurrk's innate ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that already has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Slurrk's persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2510-4217-7101.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-4217-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Semblance Anvil.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
Repeat from step 3.

3259-4373-7060.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4373-7060.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ghalta and Mavren as attackers.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-5921-5970-6791.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1632-2341-2495.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Stonespeaker Crystal and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Stonespeaker Crystal by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Stonespeaker Crystal and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Stonespeaker Crystal and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

539-2511-7034.description:
Cast Bumi by paying its mana cost
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bumi
When Bumi dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

640-2173-2292-5010.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

1562-4375-5226.description:
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Machine God's Effigy enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Machine God's Effigy.
Resolve the Machine God's Effigy trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Machine God's Effigy from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

500-1181-1309.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Salvager of Secrets and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Salvager of Secrets tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing a Salvager of Secrets token, adding an amount of {B} equal to its mana value. 
Repeat.

1274-2086-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Repeat.

632-2034-3499-3621-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-2034-3499-3621-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

500-654-2034-3125-4867.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken creature.
500-654-2034-3125-4867.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Cormela and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one of the Cormela tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Cormela that died in step 3 and the Cormela that died in step 4 each trigger, returning Victimize and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Cormela token by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Cormela token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Cormela token dies, it triggers, returning up to one instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B}, causing you to sacrifice the Cormela token and return Cormela and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the tapped permanents enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers for each one, untapping them.
Put the token Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Cormela triggers, returning up to one instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2523-5562.notablePrerequisites: Stalwarts of Osgiliath is your Ring-bearer.
2034-2523-5562.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Stalwarts of Osgiliath, adding {C}{C}.
When Stalwarts of Osgiliath dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Stalwarts of Osgiliath that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Stalwarts of Osgiliath token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Stalwarts of Osgiliath token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Repeat.

4824-5724-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
4824-5724-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Sage of the Maze's ability by tapping it, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2079-3259-5485.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
2079-3259-5485.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1233-1288-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness if it isn't a Goblin.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-1288-3259.description:
Declare Squee and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a 1/1 Goblin creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Goblin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

915-4851-5295.description:
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Thousand-Year Elixir and Timeless Lotus.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Synod Artificer.
Repeat.

372-2719-2902.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
372-2719-2902.description:
Cast Sakashima of a Thousand Faces either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Sakashima of a Thousand Faces leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Journey to Nowhere returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Journey to Nowhere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Journey to Nowhere until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Journey to Nowhere leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces to the battlefield from exile as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-3987.description:
Intruder Alarm's first ability prevents creatures from untapping during their controller's untap step.
Because Torpor Orb prevents abilities from triggering whenever a creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm's second ability does not trigger to untap them.

350-2034-2124.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional card in hand.
350-2034-2124.description:
Cast Beck by paying {G}{U}.
Activate Chivalric Alliance by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
When the Knight enters the battlefield, Beck triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Knight, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2067-2258-2542.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least thirty, minus one for each poison counter your opponents have and for each creature you control.
2067-2258-2542.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
Cast Eerie Interlude by paying {2}{W}, targeting every creature you control.
Venerated Rotpriest triggers for each creature targeted by Eerie Interlude.
Resolve the first trigger, causing an opponent to get a poison counter.
Repeat step 4 until an opponent loses the game due to having ten poison counters, then repeat for each other opponent.

2060-2445-4153.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control besides Crystalline Crawler has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
2060-2445-4153.description:
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing at least five +1/+1 counters from a creature you control and putting at least ten +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing five +1/+1 counters from Crystalline Crawler and putting ten +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing ten +1/+1 counters from that creature and putting twenty +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability ten times by removing ten +1/+1 counters, adding {8}{W}{W}.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability any number of times.
2060-2445-4153.notes: Note that the starting mana can come from activating Crystalline Crawler's mana ability. Starting mana is reduced if the creature starts with more than five +1/+1 counters on it.

215-1912-2469-2661.notablePrerequisites: Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
215-1912-2469-2661.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought by paying {1}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Phyrexian Dreadnought enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {G}, returning Phyrexian Dreadnought from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Phyrexian Dreadnought ability, failing to sacrifice it due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Repeat.

1209-1819-3740-4091-4684-5006.notablePrerequisites: Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
1209-1819-3740-4091-4684-5006.description:
Tap Alphetto Alchemist to untap itself.
Mill 1 with Mesmeric Orb.
Repeat until you mill Nullpriest of Oblivion and Syr Konrad shuffling when you do not mill them using the Titan.
Cast and kick Nullpriest of Oblivion with Lurrus of the Dream-Den, bringing Syr Konrad to the battlefield.
Repeat Milling until you mill the Titan, dealing damage with Syr Konrad.

954-2034-2302-4215.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Angel of Fury, adding {C}{C}.
Angel of Fury and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Angel of Fury trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Angel of Fury, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Repeat.
